styleLock.backgroundSystem: misty lavender stage #B7B1E6 for hero and close shots, deep violet #6F66C8 with bubble bokeh for benefit and variant shots, pale lilac #F1EEFA and white #FFFFFF for infographic and trust screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft studio key from the front-left with gentle fill, floating bubble bokeh highlights, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: round white-marble podium top with polished chrome rim, matte marble vanity counter

styleLock.presentationRules: bottle always upright and centered on the podium or counter, stable slight 3/4 hero posture and consistent scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy lavender skincare ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty lavender #B7B1E6, deep violet #6F66C8, pearl white #FFFFFF and one champagne-gold accent #E8C87A; soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle floating-bubble bokeh and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; pastel circle-badge and rounded-pill icon style; clean high-end essence-bottle photography mixed with soft infographic elements; stable upright bottle posture and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1雾紫舞台圆台主图+英文乱序标题+双胶囊标签；屏2大小双瓶+气泡背景+四个彩色圆徽+两个描边胶囊+底部三个空白图位；屏3三个空白卡片位与紫色胶囊标签+植物成分段落+粉色质地圆盘；屏4金色液滴与金珠示意+横幅标题；屏5沙漏插画与圆形标签+01/02编号要点；屏6四宫格编号卡片与分子珠插画+底部横幅；屏7皮肤剖面四联对比示意+信任标题；屏8蓝色套组与大/清/养三圆徽+产品信息表（表头产品名称、型号、保质期、平面规格）；屏9参数表续（产品功能、产品规格、主要功能、适宜人群）+白瓶实拍+素材站水印与会员二维码贴片。品类判定：参数区写明产品功能为保湿水嫩精华液、主要功能为洗护面部，使用部位为面部，故判为护肤个护/面部护理的面部精华，而非按源夹名判为洗护发。已剥离：原品牌与系列字样、英文乱序标题、素材站水印与会员二维码、原文案原句（含逆龄/抗衰/焕白等功效断言与整段重复占位文案）。原文自相矛盾处（洁面类文案与精华液品类、片装平面规格与瓶装规格、白瓶与蓝瓶套组）两种说法均未写入；原文所有数值（规格、容量、保质期、尺寸、片数）与注册证编号一律替换为 {callout_n} 或空白下划线占位，未编造任何成分浓度、检测或认证信息。
